items.source: Creates a new instance with the given format and supported mime types which only converts types for which the specified predicate returns true.
items.translation: 创建具有给定格式和仅将指定谓词返回 true 的类型的 MIME 类型的新实例。

items.source: Creates a new instance with the given format and supported mime types which only converters types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level.
items.translation: 创建具有给定格式和仅支持在类型或泛型级别上标注了`@Serializable` 的转换器类型的 MIME 类型的新实例。

items.source: Reads the given input message with the given serializer and format.
items.translation: 使用给定的序列化器和格式读取给定的输入消息。

items.source: Write the given object to the output message with the given serializer and format.
items.translation: 使用给定的序列化器和格式将给定对象写入输出消息。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 7.0, by default it only encodes types annotated with @Serializable at type or generics level since it allows combined usage with other general purpose converters without conflicts. Alternative constructors with a Predicate<ResolvableType> parameter can be used to customize this behavior.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，默认情况下仅对带有@Serializable注解的类型（在类型或泛型级别）进行编码，因为它允许与其他通用转换器结合使用且不会产生冲突。可以使用带有Predicate<ResolvableType>参数的替代构造函数来自定义此行为。

items.source: Andreas Ahlenstorf, Sebastien Deleuze, Juergen Hoeller, Iain Henderson, Arjen Poutsma
